# SteamLite 10.1.4

A better About page, the verified tick and two fixes.

- Verified players get a blue tick next to their name: on Home and your profile, in Settings > Account and About, and in Messages (chat list, the chat's header and names in group chats). Whether you are verified comes from your SteamLite account.
- Switching chats in Messages now blurs and fades the new chat in, and softens the old one while the new one loads, instead of popping.
- Fixed: in the About card, your own account showed no picture. It now shows your Steam picture and name.
- Settings > About now has links to the Discord server, the website and Instagram (@pepsiflaps), and a Made by card with the creator's SteamLite profile and an Add friend button (it needs you to be signed in to SteamLite Online).
- Fixed: a chat with a friend showed a question mark and no name. The name and picture now come from your chat list.
- Fixed: the buttons above a collection (Recently played, Delete collection, Add a game) wrapped their text into two lines. They stay on one line, and when the window is narrow the toolbar moves to its own row.
